report:
Reviewed three implementation entries and the sole associated TODO test against fixed_projection. Requirements are independent fixed native-to-shared adapters, permitted identity/adjustment/deferred-lifetime adaptations, no paired-output inspection or erasure merely to achieve agreement, and schema extension rather than loss of required distinctions. Scope is the shared model and emitter adapters; authored expr.rs checking behavior was not evaluated or approved.

rust-ref::Crate defines the shared serialized vocabulary: explicit native-normalized definition targets, semantic external path kinds, ADT/alias arguments, distinct alias kinds, reference mutability, call dispatch with trait target and Self, owner versus method substitutions, fields by owner/index, literals with value, and explicit Ref/Deref/NeverToAny nodes. The omission of lifetime distinctions matches the documented deferred lifetime representation, not an output-dependent normalization pass.

sage_emit::emit_module consumes only Sage Db/module state, preregisters identities, and translates the completed representation. ResolvedCall projection preserves selected target, dispatch, substitutions and arguments. Alias projection preserves kind/target/arguments; references preserve mutability and referenced type while omitting intentionally deferred lifetimes. sage_oracle::emit_crate consumes only TyCtxt and returns a compile error on rustc errors; its emitter independently obtains types, definition paths, substitutions, and adjustments. The oracle splits type substitutions using native generic ownership, translates builtin dereference/autoborrow/NeverToAny adjustments into shared nodes, and converts overloadable operators through native recorded targets or lang-item methods and native operand types; lazy booleans remain BinaryOp. These are fixed documented adaptations, not inspection of Sage output. External path projection on each side retains definition kinds rather than inferring them from namespace. Captured crate manifests corroborate that the oracle depends on the shared schema rather than Sage's checker/emitter.

Captured comparator source performs independent serialization and exact text comparison. Structural diff is diagnostic-only after inequality; it cannot repair omissions or wrong classification. This establishes absence of comparator repair, not completeness of every producer. In particular, both emitter files still contain unsupported expression fallbacks and debug type fallbacks, and the schema is deliberately narrower than all Rust. Captured independent_coverage.rs records the existing ignored paired-unsupported regression and explicit TODO for generic independent source inventories/coverage validation. This is a known deferred limitation: paired unsupported output is not certified as semantically faithful by this review. Required missing vocabulary still needs schema and both-projection work as functionality is added; no evidence here establishes universal rejection of unsupported output.

The only associated test, service_spec::todo::crates_sage_oracle_harness_crate_fixed_projection, has no behavioral assertions. It explicitly retains the full adapter matrix for native definition kinds, substitutions, receiver adjustments, operator calls, lifetimes, unsupported constructs, and adversarial omission/classification mismatches. Prerequisites are adapter-focused fixtures with independently specified schema observations and the generic independent coverage/inventory work already recorded for unsupported cases. Current source inspection supports independence and the represented mappings; it does not discharge this test matrix or promote fallback behavior to complete projection. No Rust edits or tests executed for this review. Commands were fresh review start/read and source inspection before recording. No additional requested edits beyond the existing explicit deferred work; coordinator was notified of the captured known unsupported-output limitation.
